title: Prop 15.136: Max+-free flat on G-orbits; m4=flat+δ; geom type insufficient; c_j character-sum form; residual OPEN
settlement_note: No soft-close. Max+-free flat_part on G-orbits for general p (resolvent of Tκ). Residual reduced to free c_j on E_4p^G only. Geometric types do not determine m4. Full Max+ Gauss for c_j still OPEN. N_ED4_SUF OPEN. L OPEN.
